verses.gurmukhi: ਲੂਲਾ ਪੈਰੀ ਹੋਦਈ ਟੰਗਾਂ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਉਠਿ ਖਲੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: loolaa pairee hodhiee Ta(n)gaa(n) maar na uTh khaloaa|

en.bdb: Though with feet, a child (man) is cripple and cannot stand upon his legs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥੋ ਹਥੁ ਨਚਾਈਐ ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧੀ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: hatho hath nachaieeaai aasaa ba(n)dhee haar paroaa|

en.bdb: Weamig the garland of hopes and desises he dances in the arms of others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੇਹਿ ਬਿਦੇਹਿ ਨ ਨਵਾਂ ਨਿਰੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: audham ukat na aaviee dheh bidheh na navaa(n) niroaa|

en.bdb: He knows neither technique nor enterprise, and being careless toward the body, he does not keep fit and healthy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਗਣ ਮੂਤਣ ਛਡਣਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਰੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: hagan mootan chhaddanaa rog sog vich dhukheeaa roaa|

en.bdb: Having no control over his excretory organs of uinating and defecation he cries of disease and suffering.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੁਟੀ ਪੀਐ ਨ ਖੁਸੀ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਪਹੁੰ ਰਖਿਅੜਾ ਅਣਖੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: ghuTee peeaai na khusee hoh sapahu(n) rakhiaRaa anakhoaa|

en.bdb: He does not take the first food (of the name of the Lord) happily and goes on catching snakes (in the form of passions and desires) stubbornly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਨ ਵਿਚਾਰਦਾ ਨ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਅਲੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: gun avagun na vichaaradhaa na upakaar vikaar aloaa|

en.bdb: Never pondering upon merits and demerits and not becoming benevolent, he always looks at evil propensities.
For such a (foolish) person, the weapon and the armour are identical.
